AI for routine work. People for judgment, feeling, thinking, creativity, and decisions. The operating model should make these responsibilities clear, build on useful existing capabilities, and measure what actually changes.

The case studies describe specific delivery work while labeling estimates, qualitative outcomes, and scope limits.
